article_manifest.title: Illegal gold panning in Mali: A destructive activity of the eco-system
article_manifest.original_title: L’orpaillage clandestin au Mali : Une activité destructrice de l’éco-système
article_manifest.summary: Illegal and mechanized gold mining in Mali poses a major ecological, economic and social threat that requires an urgent takeover of sovereignty over our resources. The Gold Paradox: Blessing or Woe? A vital sector: More than 400,000 people work directly in artisanal gold panning, supporting millions of Malians in the face of unemployment and poverty Mechanized drift: The arrival of heavy machinery (excavators, bulldozers) and dredges on riverbeds (such as the Falémé and Niger) has transformed a subsistence activity into unregulated industrial looting.
